title: OpenAI says it shares Anthropic's 'red lines' over military AI use
summary: OpenAI's Sam Altman says he shares the "red lines" set by rival Anthropic restricting how the military uses AI models, amid Anthropic's escalating feud with the Pentagon.
contentText:
OpenAI's Sam Altman says he shares the "red lines" set by rival Anthropic restricting how the military uses AI models, amid Anthropic's escalating feud with the Pentagon.

(Image credit: Julia Demaree Nikhinson)
